blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-source audio-to-image generation exhibits consistent compositional failures when audio tokens occupy geometrically displaced, semantically unanchored positions in the CLIP text-token space, where the diffusion U-Net lacks the prior to reliably attend to them or ground them in distinct spatial regions. We formalize this as the geometric displacement phenomenon and expose it through a two-level clustering analysis comparing BEATs and CLAP embeddings at the raw encoder and projected CLIP token levels. Three geometric properties emerge as important: intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that CLAP, whose contrastive language-audio pretraining aligns embeddings with natural language semantics, substantially outperforms BEATs on all three properties, improving the silhouette score by more than 3x and the Audio-Image Content score as well. Building on this analysis, we introduce a multi-token extension that requires no diffusion-backbone retraining and assigns each audio source to a distinct placeholder token in the CLIP tokenizer, complemented by a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with an A* spatial separation loss to resolve residual cross-token interference. For evaluation, we construct multi-audio compositional benchmarks from VGGSound (VGG2, VGG3, and VGGN) and extend six standard audio-image metrics to the multi-source setting. Across five benchmarks and four strong baselines, our method achieves strong results on the metrics most directly tied to compositional faithfulness, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25x over the strongest baseline and FID reduced by nearly 2x on two-source generation. We propose geometric displacement as a diagnostic framework for cross-modal generation systems that project learned embeddings into a pretrained contrastive space.
blocks.zh: 多源音频到图像生成显示,当音频符号占据了CLIP文本调试空间的几何位置时,其构象故障始终如一,在CLIP文本调试空间中,扩散U-Net缺乏可靠处理它们或在不同空间区域铺设它们之前的位置。 我们将此正式确定为几何流离失所现象,并通过对BEATs和CLAP嵌入在原始编码器和预测的CLIP符号水平的双层集群分析加以曝光。 三种几何特性作为重要特性出现:类内紧凑性,与CLIP文本的角对齐多面性,以及间距分离. 我们显示,CLAP的对比性语言-音频预训与自然语言语义的嵌入一致,在所有三个属性上都大大超过BEAT,使Silhouette分数提高3x以上,音频-图像内容分数也提高。 基于这一分析,我们引入了一个多键扩展,不需要再进行扩散背骨,并将每个音频源分配给CLIP标语器中一个独特的占位符,辅之以一个混合推论-时间目标,将Attend-and-Excite和A*空间分离损失结合起来,以解决剩余的交叉键干扰. 为了评价,我们从VGGSound(VGG2,VGG3和VGGN)构建了多音频构成基准,并将6个标准音频图像度量标准扩展到多源设置. 在5个基准和4个强基线中,我们的方法在最直接与组成忠诚度相联系的衡量标准上取得了强有力的成果,人工智能的改进比最强基线的改进达2.25x,在双源生成上,FID减少了近2x。 我们建议将几何迁移作为跨模式生成系统的诊断框架,将学习到的系统嵌入一个预先训练的对比空间。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Compositional audio-to-image generation with our method. The top row progressively adds four audio sources ( snare drum, underwater bubbling, volcano explosion, church bell ringing ), while the bottom row shows a three-source example ( church bell, singing choir, drum kit ). Each new object is added to a separate, spatially consistent region while preserving earlier concepts. Our analysis suggests that this behavior is strongly influenced by the geometry of audio tokens in CLIP space, which we quantify in Section 3.3 , use to redesign the embedder in Section 3 , and further refine through our mixed inference-time objective.
blocks.zh: 图1:用我们的方法制作的构成式音频到图像。 上行逐渐增加了四个音源(螺旋鼓,水下泡泡,火山爆炸,教堂钟响),而下行显示一个三源的例子(教堂钟声,唱合唱团,鼓套). 每个新物体被添加到一个单独的,空间一致的区域,同时保留早期的概念. 我们的分析表明,这种行为受到CLIP空间中音频符号几何学的强烈影响,我们在3.3节中将音频符号量化,用于重新设计第3节的嵌入器,并通过我们混合的推论时间目标来进一步完善.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sound in real-world environments is naturally multi-source. A street scene may contain traffic, conversation, and birdsong, while a kitchen scene may include running water, footsteps, and appliance noise. Despite recent progress in audio-conditioned image synthesis [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz , Biner et al.(2024)Biner, Sofian, Karakaş, Ceylan, Erdem, and Erdem , Sung-Bin et al.(2023)Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh ] , most existing methods operate on only a single audio clip and therefore generate single-object scenes. A natural extension is to generate a coherent image from multiple audio inputs, where each sound source is represented in the final scene. We refer to this task as compositional audio-to-image generation (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在现实世界环境中的声音自然是多源的. 街道场景可能包含交通,谈话,和鸟鸣,而厨房场景则可能包括自来水,脚步和器械噪音. 尽管最近在音频条件图像合成方面取得了进展[Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz, Biner et al.(2024) Biner, Sofian, Karakaş, Ceylan, Erdem, and Erdem, Sung-Bin et al.(2023) Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh],但大多数现有方法只在一个音频短片上运行,因此产生单对象场景. 一个自然的延伸是从多个音频输入生成一个连贯的图像,其中每个声音源在最后的场景中都有代表. 我们将此任务称为组成式音频到图像生成(图1).

blocks.en: Extending single-audio methods directly to multiple audio sources results in consistent failure modes. Concatenating multiple audio embeddings into a single conditioning token collapses the sources into an averaged representation. Using multiple audio-derived tokens in the prompt introduces a different problem: the diffusion model often ignores all but one token, generating only one object or merging multiple objects into a semantically unclear result. This behavior is related to the catastrophic neglect problem observed in text-conditioned diffusion models [ Chefer et al.(2023)Chefer, Alaluf, Vinker, Wolf, and Cohen-Or ] . Figure 2 illustrates this behavior in AudioToken [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] , where the cross-attention maps of two audio tokens collapse into the same spatial region during denoising. Our mixed objective explicitly separates these attention maps.
blocks.zh: 将单声道方法直接推广到多个音频源,导致一致的故障模式. 将多个音频嵌入到单个调值符中,使来源崩溃为平均表示. 在提示中使用多个音频衍生的符号会引入不同的问题:扩散模型往往忽略除一个符号以外的所有符号,只生成一个对象或者将多个对象合并成一个模糊不清的结果. 这种行为与文本条件传播模型中观察到的灾难性忽视问题有关[Chefer等人(2023年),Chefer, Alaluf, Vinker, Wolf, and Cohen-Or]. 图2在AudioToken [Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv,Gat,Wolf,Adi,和Schwartz]中说明了这一行为,其中两个音频符号的交叉意向图在解密期间崩溃于同一个空间区域. 我们的混合目标明确区分了这些关注地图.

blocks.en: Our analysis suggests that these failures are strongly influenced by the geometry of the conditioning space. In diffusion models, cross-attention computes similarities between image features and conditioning tokens, which are typically CLIP text embeddings drawn from a well-structured semantic space [ Radford et al.(2021)Radford, Kim, Hallacy, Ramesh, Goh, Agarwal, Sastry, Askell, Mishkin, Clark, Krueger, and Sutskever ] . When audio-derived tokens are inserted into this space, three geometric properties become important: i) Intra-class compactness. Audio embeddings from the same semantic class should form compact clusters. Otherwise, the diffusion model receives inconsistent conditioning signals across samples. ii) Angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold. Cross-attention depends more strongly on cosine similarity than Euclidean distance. Tokens that preserve angular alignment with the CLIP text space can still behave like text tokens even if their absolute magnitude differs. iii) Spatial separation of attention maps. When multiple audio tokens are present, each should activate strongly, and their cross-attention maps should occupy different image regions. Weak activation causes neglect, while overlapping maps cause object fusion (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的分析表明,这些故障受到调节空间几何学的强烈影响. 在扩散模型中,交叉意念计算图像特征与调制符的相似性,这些通常都是CLIP文本嵌入自结构完善的语义空间[拉德福德等人(2021年)拉德福德,金,哈莱西,拉梅什,戈赫,阿加尔瓦尔,萨斯特里,阿斯凯尔,米什金,克拉克,克鲁格,苏茨克韦尔]. 当在这个空间中插入音频衍生的符号时,三个几何属性变得重要: (一) 类内紧凑性. 同一语义类的音频嵌入物应形成紧凑的集群. 否则,扩散模型在样本中接收到不一致的调节信号. (二) 与 CLIP 文本的多重对齐。 与欧几利得距离相比,交叉注意力更依赖于余弦相似性. 保留与 CLIP 文本空间的角对齐的托肯仍然可以表现为文本符,即使其绝对大小不同. (三) 注意力分布图的空间分离。 当存在多个音频符号时,每个符号应强烈激活,它们的交叉注意地图应占据不同的图像区域. 弱激活导致忽略,而重叠的地图则导致物体聚变(图2).

blocks.en: These properties can be directly measured and used to guide model design. We show that the BEATs encoder used in prior work [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] yields weak cluster geometry, with low intra-class compactness and poor separation in both the raw embedding space and the projected CLIP token space. In contrast, CLAP [ Wu et al.(2023)Wu, Chen, Zhang, Hui, Berg-Kirkpatrick, and Dubnov ] produces more compact and better-aligned embeddings, improving silhouette score by more than 3 × 3\times . More importantly, CLAP embeddings preserve angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, a key property for stable cross-attention. Based on this geometric view, we make the following contributions: i) We provide a geometric analysis of how existing audio-to-image models fail in the compositional setting, using clustering in both the raw audio embedding space and the projected CLIP token space. ii) We introduce a CLAP-based embedder redesigned around CLAP’s global 512 512 -dimensional representation, producing significantly improved cluster geometry compared to BEATs. iii) We propose a multi-token extension (MTE) that assigns each audio source to a separate placeholder token, enabling compositional conditioning without retraining the diffusion backbone. iv) We introduce a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with the A ∗ spatial loss, jointly enforcing strong token activation and spatial separation of attention maps. v) We construct three new compositional benchmarks, VGG2, VGG3 and VGGn, together with multi-source extensions of standard audio-to-image evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 这些属性可以直接测量,用来指导模型设计. 我们显示,在以前的工作中使用的BEATs编码器[Yariv等人(2023年)Yariv、Gat、Wolf、Adi和Schwartz]产生弱聚几何,在原始嵌入空间和预测的CLIP符号空间中,类内紧凑度低,分离性差。 相比之下,CLAP [Wu et al.(2023)Wu, Chen, 张,惠,伯格-柯克帕特里克(Berg-Kirkpatrick)和杜布诺夫(Dubnov)))生产更紧凑,更搭配的嵌入,将硅胶分数提升了3×3×%以上. 更重要的是,CLAP嵌入物保持了与CLIP文本复数的角对齐,这是稳定交叉注意力的关键属性. 基于这一几何观点,我们作出以下贡献: 一. 我们通过在原始音频嵌入空间和预测的CLIP符号空间进行分组,对现有音频到图像模型如何在组成设置中失败进行几何分析。 (二) 我们推出一个基于CLAP的嵌入器,重新设计环绕CLAP的全球512 512维代表,与BEAT相比,产生了显著改进的集群几何学. 页:1 我们提议一个多键扩展(MTE),将每个音频源分配到一个单独的占位符上,从而能够在不重新培训传播主干的情况下进行成分调节。 (四)我们引入了混合推论-时间目标,将表率-Excite和A * 空间损失相结合,共同实施强大的符号激活和注意力地图的空间分离. 五、结 论 我们构建了三个新的构成基准,即VGG2,VGG3和VGGn,以及标准音频到图像评价指标的多源扩展.

blocks.en: Across five benchmarks (VGG, IS3, VGG2, VGG3, and VGGn) and against four strong baselines (AudioToken, SonicDiffusion, Sound2Scene, and MACS), our variants achieve the best performance on the metrics most closely related to compositional generation, including AIC, IIS, and FID. The CLAP variant is strongest in distribution, improving AIC by up to 2.25 × 2.25\times , while the BEATs variant leads on the out-of-distribution IS3 benchmark.
blocks.zh: 在五个基准(VGG、IS3、VGG2、VGG3和VGGn)和四个强基线(AudioToken、SonicDifculation、Sound2Scene和MACS)上,我们的变体在与组成生成最密切相关的衡量标准上取得了最佳业绩,包括AIC、IIS和FID。 CLAP变体在分布上最强,改进了AIC最多2.25×2.25\时,而BEATs变体则领先于分配外IS3基准.

blocks.en: Our method operates on separate audio sources, which naturally align with settings such as instrument recordings, studio audio tracks, or labeled datasets. When only mixed audio is available, any source separation method such as Demucs [ Défossez(2021) ] can be used as a preprocessing step. Our framework is independent of the specific source separation method used.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在单独的音频源上运行,这些音频源自然符合仪器录音,录音室音频音轨,或标签数据集等设置. 当只有混合音频可用时,任何如Demucs[Défossez(2021)]等源分离方法都可以用作预处理步骤. 我们的框架独立于所使用的特定源分离方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early audio-to-image (A2I) methods were mainly based on conditional GANs. Sound2Scene [ Sung-Bin et al.(2023)Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh ] trains a conditional GAN on a self-supervised image latent space and then aligns an audio encoder with that space. More recent diffusion-based approaches achieve much higher image quality. SonicDiffusion [ Biner et al.(2024)Biner, Sofian, Karakaş, Ceylan, Erdem, and Erdem ] maps CLAP audio features to tokens and injects them into a frozen Stable Diffusion U-Net via gated audio-image cross-attention layers. AudioToken [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] , which our work builds upon, formulates A2I generation as textual inversion [ Gal et al.(2023)Gal, Alaluf, Atzmon, Patashnik, Bermano, Chechik, and Cohen-Or ] , projecting BEATs [ Chen et al.(2023)Chen, Wu, Wang, Liu, Tompkins, Chen, and Wei ] audio features into a learned token inserted into the CLIP text prompt of a frozen Stable Diffusion model [ Rombach et al.(2022)Rombach, Blattmann, Lorenz, Esser, and Ommer ] . The most closely related prior work is MACS [ Zhou et al.(2025)Zhou, Cheng, Yu, and Tian ] , which tackles multi-source A2I by first separating mixed audio using a weakly supervised CLAP-aligned module and a ranking loss, and then mapping each separated signal to the generator via a lightweight adapter. In contrast, we assume separate audio streams and instead address the geometry of audio tokens in CLIP space, thereby repairing cross-attention behavior directly within the denoising loop.
blocks.zh: 早期的音频对图像(A2I)方法主要基于有条件的GAN. Sound2Scene [Sung-Bin et al.(2023)Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh]在自控图像潜伏空间上培训有条件的GAN,然后将音频编码器与该空间对齐. 较近期的推广方法能提高图像质量。 SonicDifusion [Biner et al.(2024)Biner,Sofian,Karakaş,Ceylan,Erdem,和Erdem]将CLAP的音频特性映射到符文上,并通过有门的音频图像交叉投影层将其注入冷冻的Stable Difusion U-Net. AudioToken[Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv、Gat、Wolf、Adi和Schwartz]是我们工作的基础,它把A2I代作为文字倒置[Gal et al.(2023)Gal、Alaluf、Atzmon、Patashnik、Bermano、Chechik和Cohen-Or], 投射BEATs[Chen et al.(2023)Chen, Wu, Wang, Liu, Tompkins, Chen, and Wei] 音效特性插入到CLIP文本的提示中,一个冷冻的分化模型[Rombach et al.(2022)Rombach, Blattmann, Lorenz, Esser, and Ommer]. 之前最密切相关的作品是MACS[周 et等(2025年)周hou,. 郑 Yu, and Tian]),它处理多源的A2I,首先使用受弱监督的CLAP对齐模块和排名损失来分离混合音频,然后通过轻量级适配器将每个分离的信号映射到生成器. 相比之下,我们假设单独的音频流,而是解决CLIP空间中音频符的几何问题,从而直接修复去诺音循环内的交叉注意行为.

blocks.en: Compositional text-to-image generation. Diffusion models are known to suffer from catastrophic neglect [ Chefer et al.(2023)Chefer, Alaluf, Vinker, Wolf, and Cohen-Or ] , where one or more subjects in a multi-object prompt are ignored during generation. Attend-and-Excite [ Chefer et al.(2023)Chefer, Alaluf, Vinker, Wolf, and Cohen-Or ] addresses this issue by monitoring the cross-attention activation of subject tokens during denoising and updating the latent representation when activations become weak. Structured Diffusion Guidance [ Feng et al.(2023)Feng, He, Fu, Jampani, Akula, Narayana, Basu, Wang, and Wang ] decomposes prompts into separate noun phrases routed through different attention pathways. Other approaches, such as A ∗ [ Agarwal et al.(2023)Agarwal, Karanam, Joseph, Saxena, Goswami, and Srinivasan ] and BoxDiff [ Xie et al.(2023)Xie, Li, Huang, Liu, Zhang, Zheng, and Shou ] , introduce spatial constraints that reduce overlap between attention maps or enforce bounding-box consistency. Our work extends this line of research to the audio-conditioned setting. Audio-derived tokens can occupy a different geometric region in CLIP space from natural text tokens, which can make compositional conditioning more challenging (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 组成文字对图像生成. 传播模型已知会遭受灾难性的忽视[Chefer等人(2023年) Chefer, Alaluf, Vinker, Wolf, 和 Cohen-Or] ,其中多对象提示中的一个或多个主体在生成时会被忽略. [Cefer等人(2023)Chefer、Alaluf、Vinker、Wolf和Cohen-Or]出席讨论,通过在激活变得薄弱时监测对主题符号的交叉注意激活,并更新潜在表示。 结构化扩散指导[冯等人(2023)Feng,He,Fu,Jampani,Akula,Narayana,Basu,Wang,和Wang]]通过不同的关注路径将导词分解为单独的名词短语. 其他方法,如A ∗ [Agarwal 等人(2023年) Agarwal、Karanam、Joseph、Saxena、Goswami和Srinivasan]和BoxDiff [Xie 等人(2023年)Xie, 丽 黄 刘 张 Zheng, and Shou]),引入了空间限制,以减少注意力图之间的重叠或强制约束框一致性. 我们的工作将这一条研究线延伸至有声环境。 音频衍生的代号可以占用CLIP空间中与自然文本代号不同的几何区域,这可以使构件条件更具挑战性(第3.3节).

blocks.en: Audio representation learning. The effectiveness of audio-conditioned generation can depend strongly on the geometry of the underlying audio embeddings. BEATs [ Chen et al.(2023)Chen, Wu, Wang, Liu, Tompkins, Chen, and Wei ] is a self-supervised audio transformer trained using masked acoustic-token prediction and produces frame-level embeddings of dimension 768 768 . In contrast, CLAP [ Wu et al.(2023)Wu, Chen, Zhang, Hui, Berg-Kirkpatrick, and Dubnov ] is a contrastive language-audio model trained on approximately 633 633 K audio-text pairs, producing a global 512 512 -dimensional embedding aligned with natural language semantics. We use CLAP because its embeddings preserve important geometric properties such as compact clustering and angular separation, which remain stable after projection into the CLIP text-token space and improve cross-attention behavior.
blocks.zh: 音频代表学习. 音频条件生成的有效性可以强烈依赖于基础音频嵌入的几何. BEATs [陈等人(2023年)Chen, 吴,王,刘,汤普金斯,陈,魏]是一个自控的音频变压器,使用蒙面声控预测进行训练,并产生768 768. 相比之下,CLAP [Wu et al.(2023)Wu, Chen, 张,惠,伯格-柯克帕特里克(英語:Berg-Kirkpatrick, and Dubnov)]是一个对比性语言-音频模型,训练了约633 633 K音频文本对联,产生了全球512 512维嵌入与自然语言语义一致. 我们使用CLAP是因为其嵌入物保存了重要的几何属性,如紧凑集群和角分离,在投射到CLIP文本键空间后保持稳定,并改进了交叉注意力行为.

blocks.en: Audio source separation. Audio source separation [ Défossez(2021) ] is a separate and well-studied problem. Our method assumes that individual audio sources are already separated and does not rely on any specific source-separation model. When only mixed audio is available, any existing separation method can be used as a preprocessing step.

blocks.en: 3.3 The Geometry of Audio Tokens in CLIP Space
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 CLIP 空间中音频托肯的几何

blocks.en: Before describing our method, we first present the main observation that motivates it. In the diffusion backbone, all conditioning tokens are processed identically. Cross-attention is computed using inner products between visual queries and conditioning keys. As a result, whether an audio token is attended to depends on where that token lies in the CLIP text-token space, relative to both (i) other tokens from the same semantic class and (ii) the natural text embedding manifold on which the diffusion model was trained. We study these relationships at two levels.
blocks.zh: 在描述我们的方法之前,我们首先提出了促使它的主要观察。 在扩散骨干中,所有调制符都得到相同的处理. 交叉注意是使用视觉查询和调制键之间的内置产品计算的。 因此,音频符号是否得到处理,取决于该符号位于CLIP文本调值空间中的位置,相对于(一)同一语义类的其他符号和(二)用于培训传播模型的嵌入多面体的自然文本。 我们在两个层面研究这些关系。

blocks.en: Level 1: Raw Audio Embeddings. We first extract embeddings from a 50 50 -class subset of VGGSound (Section 3.7 ) using BEATs and CLAP. We then evaluate the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized embeddings using standard clustering metrics: within-cluster variance (WCV, lower is better), Davies–Bouldin index (DB, lower is better), silhouette score (higher is better), and mean intra-cluster cosine similarity (higher is better).

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , CLAP produces significantly better cluster structure than BEATs. The silhouette score improves by more than 3 × 3\times ( 0.0295 0.0295 vs. 0.0090 0.0090 ), DB decreases by 21 % 21\% , and WCV decreases from 0.545 0.545 to 0.470 0.470 . These results indicate that BEATs places audio clips from the same class in less consistent geometric locations, which can make the downstream embedding mapping more difficult to learn.

blocks.en: We further measure the distance between each class centroid and the CLIP text embedding of the corresponding class label. Two observations are important. First, CLAP tokens are farther from the text embeddings in ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance ( 0.825 0.825 vs. 0.298 0.298 ), which may initially suggest weaker alignment. However, the cosine distance remains nearly identical ( 0.639 0.639 vs. 0.661 0.661 ). Since cross-attention depends on normalized inner products, angular alignment is more important than Euclidean distance. This suggests that CLAP tokens retain comparable angular alignment with the text manifold while also being more clearly separated from each other. Figure 4 visualizes this behavior.

blocks.en: This geometric property offers a useful explanation for the consistent advantage of CLAP over BEATs in our experiments. More generally, it suggests that an audio encoder for diffusion conditioning does not need to exactly match text embeddings in ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance. The projected feature is then passed through a residual block consisting of LayerNorm, Linear, GELU, and Dropout layers. blocks.en: 3.7 Training on a Focused 50-Class Subset
blocks.zh: 3.7 关于重点50级子集的培训

blocks.en: We train the embedder on a curated 50 50 -class subset of VGGSound ( ∼ \sim 25K audio–image pairs) instead of the full 309 309 -class dataset. The main reason is representational capacity. The embedder contains only ∼ \sim 8.3M trainable parameters, and learning mappings for all 309 309 classes, many of which are visually similar or acoustically ambiguous, can make optimization unstable and lead to weaker token separation. By restricting training to 50 50 acoustically and visually distinct classes, the task becomes easier for the embedder to learn. This helps produce cleaner gradients, more stable optimization, and tighter token clusters in CLIP space. The effect is also reflected quantitatively in the clustering results shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们训练嵌入器使用一个50-级的VGGSoud子集(\\sim 25K音频-图像对),而不是完整的309-级数据集。 主要原因是代表能力。 嵌入器仅包含 \\sim 8.3M 可列车参数,所有309 309 类的学习绘图,其中许多目视相似或声学模糊,可以使优化不稳定,导致符号分离更弱. 通过将培训限制在50个声学和视觉不同的班级,任务就更容易让嵌入者学习。 这有助于在CLIP空间中产生更清洁的梯度,更稳定的优化,更紧凑的符号集群. 这一影响在数量上也反映在表1所示的分组结果中。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: VGGSound [ Chen et al.(2020)Chen, Xie, Vedaldi, and Zisserman ] is a large-scale audio-visual dataset containing approximately 200 200 K audio clips of length 10 10 seconds across 309 309 classes, each paired with a sampled image frame. We train our embedder on a curated 50 50 -class subset and use its test split for single-audio evaluation, which we refer to as VGG . Classes outside this training vocabulary are treated as out-of-distribution. IS3 [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] (Interactive Synthetic Sound Source) is a compositional benchmark that includes two audio clips from different classes, along with a synthesized composite reference image. We use IS3 as an out-of-distribution multi-audio benchmark because its compositions are drawn from a broader, partially non-overlapping vocabulary.
blocks.zh: VGGSound [Chen et al.(2020)Chen, Xie, Vedaldi, and Zisserman]是一个大型的视听数据集,包含约200,200K长10秒的音频剪辑,跨309,309个班次,每个班次都配对有一个样本的图像帧. 我们用50个50级的子集来训练嵌入器, 这种培训词汇以外的课程被视为分配外。 IS3 [Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz] (交互合成音源)是一个组成基准,包含来自不同类的两段音频剪辑,以及一个合成综合参考图像. 我们使用IS3作为分配外的多音频基准,因为它的构成来自一个更广泛的,部分不重叠的词汇.

blocks.en: New compositional benchmarks (VGG2, VGG3, VGGn). To evaluate compositional generation under controlled settings, we construct three multi-audio benchmarks from the VGGSound test split. VGG2 contains 2500 2500 groups, each consisting of exactly two audio-image pairs sampled from different classes. VGG3 contains 1000 1000 groups of three audio-image pairs and supports a more detailed analysis of the three-audio setting. VGGn contains 500 500 groups with variable group size n ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } n\in\{2,3,4,5\} . To ensure balanced class coverage, we sample a group size uniformly, then select acoustically distinct classes without replacement, giving preference to classes that have not yet appeared in earlier groups. Audio-image pairs within each class are drawn sequentially, ensuring all samples are used before being reused. All splits are generated with a fixed random seed.
blocks.zh: 新的构成基准(VGG2,VGG3,VGGn). 为了评价在受控环境下的组分生成,我们从VGGSound测试分裂中构建了三个多音频基准. VGG2包含2500 2500组,每组由从不同班级抽取的完全两组音频图像对组成. VGG3包含10001000组3个音频图像配对,并支持对3个音频设定进行更详细的分析. VGGn包含500组,可变组大小为n {2,3,4,5}n\in\2,3,4,5}. 为确保班级覆盖均衡,我们抽取一个统一的班级规模,然后选择声学上不同的班级而不进行替换,优先选择在早期班级中尚未出现的班级. 每一类中的音频图像对按顺序绘制,确保所有样本在重新使用之前都使用。 所有分裂都是用固定的随机种子生成的.

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量

blocks.en:
We extend six standard audio-to-image metrics to the multi-source setting. For groups with n n audio inputs, each metric is aggregated across all n n objects in the group. IIS (Image–Image Similarity) measures how often the generated image is more similar, in CLIP ViT-L/14 space, to its ground-truth reference than to random references; higher is better. AIS (Audio–Image Similarity) is
the analogous win rate between the generated image (CLIP ViT-B/32) and the wav2CLIP [ Wu et al.(2022)Wu, Seetharaman, Kumar, and Bello ] embedding of each input audio, ranked against random audios. AIC (Audio–Image Content) is the recall of the n n ground-truth labels within the top- n n predictions of a zero-shot CLIP ViT-L/14 classifier over the 50 50 candidate classes, reducing to top-1 accuracy when n = 1 n=1 . CLS (Caption-Label Similarity) is the geometric mean, over labels, of the cosine
similarity between a BLIP [ Li et al.(2022)Li, Li, Xiong, and Hoi ] -generated caption and each class label. CCS (Caption–Caption Similarity) is the same aggregation between captions of the generated and reference images. FID [ Heusel et al.(2017)Heusel, Ramsauer, Unterthiner, Nessler, and Hochreiter ] measures the distributional distance between generated and real images in InceptionV3 feature space, where lower values are better.
Five of these six metrics use CLIP- or BLIP-derived representations, which our method also aligns to, so we report FID alongside them as a CLIP-independent check. Moreover, the coupling is indirect, since our inference-time objective acts on cross-attention maps and never optimizes CLIP image–text similarity.

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines and Variants
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线和备选案文

blocks.en: We compare our method with four existing approaches: AudioToken [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] trained on the full 309 309 -class VGGSound dataset (denoted as AT (309) ), SonicDiffusion [ Biner et al.(2024)Biner, Sofian, Karakaş, Ceylan, Erdem, and Erdem ] , Sound2Scene [ Sung-Bin et al.(2023)Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh ] , and MACS [ Zhou et al.(2025)Zhou, Cheng, Yu, and Tian ] . For a fair comparison, each baseline receives the same pre-separated audio sources as our method, so that differences reflect the generation stage rather than source-separation quality. For MACS, which includes a source separation stage, we bypass this stage and provide the same separated sources directly to its generation module. AT (309) uses the released 309 309 -class AudioToken weights with our multi-token extension at inference, so it also produces one combined image per group and remains directly comparable. We denote our variants as follows: AT , which uses the multi-token extension with the BEATs encoder trained on the curated 50 50 -class subset; AT Mixed , which adds the mixed inference objective ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\text{mix}} ; and AT Mixed (Clap) , which further replaces BEATs with the CLAP encoder. This final variant (AT Mixed (Clap)) is referred to as “Ours” in the figures. In all tables, the best result in each column is highlighted in violet , while the second-best result is shown in bold . Rows corresponding to our variants are shaded.

CLAP produces a single global embedding aligned to a fixed language vocabulary, so audio outside that vocabulary may be mapped toward familiar concepts, potentially reducing the detail needed to render the correct object. BEATs is instead trained by masked acoustic-token prediction over the broad AudioSet distribution, with no text alignment, and it exposes a frame-level feature sequence rather than a single compressed vector, so it degrades more gracefully on unseen classes. The angular alignment that benefits CLAP in-distribution may therefore be less effective when the test audio falls outside the learned vocabulary, as on IS3, where the broader features of BEATs provide better robustness. Extending the embedder to broader training vocabularies is a direction for future work, as discussed in Appendix G G .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We addressed the problem of compositional audio-to-image generation by studying the geometry of audio tokens in the CLIP text-token space. Our analysis identifies three key properties spanning intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that these properties are closely associated with common failure modes in existing methods, and we design our framework to address each. Although our method builds on existing components such as textual inversion, Attend-and-Excite, and A ∗ separation, it combines them within a unified geometric framework. The proposed approach achieves strong performance on compositional metrics such as AIC, IIS, and FID, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25 × \times over prior methods. We also introduce three new multi-source benchmarks, VGG2, VGG3, and VGGn, to support future research in compositional audio-to-image generation. While our study focuses on audio, the proposed geometric perspective may extend to other modalities that project learned embeddings into pre-trained text spaces for cross-attention.
blocks.zh: 我们通过研究CLIP文本键空间中音频符的几何学,解决了构件音频到图像生成的问题. 我们的分析查明了三个关键属性,包括类内紧凑性、与文本多面一致的角化和间距分离。 我们显示,这些特性与现有方法中常见的失败模式密切相关,我们设计我们的框架来解决每一种问题。 虽然我们的方法建立在文本反转,Attend-and-Excite,以及A ∗分离等现有组成部分上,但它在统一的几何框架内将它们结合起来. 拟议的方法在诸如AIC、IIS和FID等组成衡量标准上取得了强有力的业绩,AIC比以前的方法改进了最多2.25xx时间。 我们还引入了三个新的多源基准,即VGG2,VGG3和VGGn,以支持未来在组成音频到图像生成方面的研究. 虽然我们的研究侧重于音频,但拟议的几何视角可能扩大到项目所学到的其他模式,这些模式嵌入预先训练过的文本空间,供交叉注意。

blocks.en: Limitations. Our method assumes separated audio streams and inherits the limitations of any external separation model. The embedder is trained on a curated 50 50 -class subset, so broader vocabularies require additional training. FID [ Heusel et al.(2017)Heusel, Ramsauer, Unterthiner, Nessler, and Hochreiter ] is accumulated across the whole benchmark rather than
computed per group. Each group contributes its n n reference images to the real
set and, paired with each reference, its single generated image to the generated
set, so the generated image enters with multiplicity n n and the two sets stay
balanced (real 1 , gen, real 2 , gen, … \dots ). The Fréchet distance is then
computed once from the InceptionV3 statistics accumulated over all groups, with
lower values indicating closer distributions.

Baseline reproduction. AudioToken [ Yariv et al.(2023)Yariv, Gat, Wolf, Adi, and Schwartz ] , SonicDiffusion [ Biner et al.(2024)Biner, Sofian, Karakaş, Ceylan, Erdem, and Erdem ] ,
Sound2Scene [ Sung-Bin et al.(2023)Sung-Bin, Senocak, Ha, Owens, and Oh ] , and MACS [ Zhou et al.(2025)Zhou, Cheng, Yu, and Tian ] are run from their official public implementations with default hyperparameters. For multi-audio evaluation, AT (309) uses the released 309 309 -class AudioToken weights together with our multi-token extension, so that a group of n n sources is registered to n n placeholder tokens in a single prompt and produces one combined image, exactly as for our own variants. Its embedder architecture is identical to that of our AT variant, so the two differ only in the training vocabulary of the embedder. SonicDiffusion and Sound2Scene accept a single audio input and are therefore reported on VGG only. Since our benchmarks already provide separated sources, we bypass the weakly supervised separation stage of MACS and pass the separated sources directly to its adapter, matching the separated-input assumption shared by all methods and isolating the comparison to the generation stage.

blocks.en: Why does the geometric framing explain the results? The ablation results closely follow the three geometric properties introduced in Section 3 3 . CLAP produces more compact clusters than BEATs at both levels of the clustering analysis (Table 1 1 and Figure 4 4 ), and this directly matches the improvement in AIC across both single-audio and compositional benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为什么几何框架能解释结果? 衰减的结果紧跟第3条第3款提出的三个几何属性。 CLAP在集群分析(表1和图4 4)两个层次上产生比BEAT更紧凑的集群,这直接与AIC在单声道和组成基准上的改进相匹配.

blocks.en: Angular alignment with the text manifold also explains why the larger L2 distance of CLAP tokens does not hurt performance. Although CLAP tokens are farther from text embeddings in Euclidean distance, their angular alignment remains strong, which is what matters for cross-attention.
blocks.zh: 与文本多面体的角调和也解释了为什么CLAP符号的较大L2距离不会损害性能. 虽然CLAP的符号比在欧几利得距离内嵌文字要远,但是它们的角对齐仍然很强,这才是需要交叉注意的.

blocks.en: Finally, inter-token spatial separation controlled by ℒ A ∗ \mathcal{L}_{\text{A}^{*}} improves metrics related to clean object separation, such as CLS and CCS. The ablation results confirm this behavior. Overall, the geometric framing yields clear, testable predictions that are consistently supported by the experiments.
blocks.zh: 最后,由L A 控制 \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{A}^{*}}}改进了与清洁对象分离相关的度量衡,如CLS和CCS. 衰竭结果证实了这种行为. 总的来说,几何框架产生明确的、可测试的预测,这些预测始终得到实验的支持。

blocks.en:
Why is the CLAP advantage smaller on IS3? The reversal on IS3 comes from how the two encoders are trained rather than from
the size of the embedder’s training vocabulary. CLAP is optimized contrastively
to align each clip with a fixed set of language concepts and compresses it into a
single global embedding. This is what gives CLAP its tight, well-separated
clusters and its strong in-distribution performance, but the alignment only holds
for concepts seen during pretraining. When an IS3 clip belongs to a class outside
that vocabulary, its embedding drifts toward the nearest familiar concept, and the
projected token loses the discriminative detail needed to render the correct
object.

blocks.en: Why does performance drop at larger n n ? As the number of audio sources increases ( n = 4 n=4 or 5 5 ), the cross-attention at each spatial location must be shared across more tokens. Even when tokens are well separated in CLIP space, some tokens may still receive insufficient attention during generation.
blocks.zh: 为什么性能下降到更大的nn? 随着音频源的数量增加(n = 4 n = 4 或 5 5 ),每个空间位置的交叉意向必须在更多的信使之间共享. 即使信物在CLIP空间中分离良好,一些信物在生成过程中仍然可能得不到足够的关注.

blocks.en: The A ∗ loss helps reduce overlap by spreading attention maps across different regions, but it cannot increase the total available attention. Higher image resolutions or explicit control of per-token attention allocation may help address this issue in future work.
blocks.zh: A* 损失通过将注意力分布在不同地区有助于减少重叠,但无法增加现有注意力总量。 更高的图像分辨率或明确控制对每一关注的分配,可能有助于在今后的工作中解决这一问题。

blocks.en: Why are CLS and CCS not always the highest for our method? CLS and CCS depend on BLIP-generated captions, which summarize the entire image into a single sentence. As scene complexity increases, these captions become less reliable at correctly describing every individual object. This can lower CLS and CCS scores even when the generated objects are visually accurate.
blocks.zh: 为什么CLS和CCS 不总是我们的方法最高? CLS和CCS依赖于BLIP生成的字幕,这些字幕将整个图像归纳为单句. 随着场景复杂性的增加,这些标题在正确描述每个单个对象时变得不那么可靠. 这可以降低CLS和CCS的分数,即使生成的物体是视觉准确的.

blocks.en: Methods that generate simpler scenes may therefore obtain artificially better scores on these metrics. For this reason, we consider AIC the most reliable metric for compositional generation, as it directly assesses whether each object class is correctly recognized in the generated image.
blocks.zh: 因此,产生更简单场景的方法可能在这些指标上人为地获得更好的分数。 因此,我们认为AIC是组成生成的最可靠的衡量标准,因为它直接评估每个对象类是否在生成的图像中被正确识别.
